discovery: Theoretical prediction and experimental discovery of topological insulators and the quantum spin Hall effect
motivation: Kane and Mele showed in 2005 that time-reversal-invariant insulators carry a Z2 topological invariant, predicting the quantum spin Hall state with protected helical edge channels. This opened a new classification of electronic matter beyond Landau symmetry breaking. In 2007 Molenkamp and co-workers, after years of perfecting HgTe/CdTe quantum wells, observed quantized edge conductance, the first experimental topological insulator. Three-dimensional topological insulators, their Dirac surface states, the quantum anomalous Hall effect, axion electrodynamics and proposals for Majorana-based qubits all grew directly from these works. Thousands of laboratories worldwide now study topological materials, and topological band theory has become a basic tool of materials science. The discovery is a model of theory predicting a new state of matter and painstaking materials growth confirming it. Shou-Cheng Zhang, who made essential contributions, is sadly no longer living.
